description: Estacionament Nocturn Permés BUS / Estacionamiento Nocturno Permitido BUS is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Información geográfica del estacionamiento nocturno permitido para los buses. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Transportation, Urban planning and infraestructure. Its keywords are Transport networks, Buildings. The portal shows 26 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
